title: Common Floor Contra Dance
specs: Wide range of ages and experience levels
Live band plays on dance floor or stage
Expect a high number of inexperienced dancers
Practice good communication and ask for consent
Plenty of parking in dedicated lot or on street; can unload gear at front door
blurb: Common Floor Contra Dance hosts contra dance events featuring live music and a caller who leads dances. Each event includes a beginner lesson, a break with waltzes, and two halves of dancing. The events emphasize inclusivity, safety, and a welcoming atmosphere for all experience levels.
extraNote: Check the weather; try not to cancel within 2 days of the dance · Events are drug and alcohol free · Guns and weapons not allowed · Temple Beth El, 400 Deering Ave, Portland, ME
